cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault; first funding may use wallet-signed CreateAccount or a native Payment to avoid public-account precreation griefing. Connected-wallet support for both remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; open design, implementation, and release work remains. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection remains unresolved and source helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commits 756ff1a5 and eb379f9c add Stellar network-bound provider configuration and transaction-status transport/transform registration. Commit 9f8eb5a7 adds a registered pure `deposit_evidence` module: exact 2-of-3 receipt-list quorum with dissent rejection, reserve timestamp/sequence freshness gate, and first-funding credit decision with permanent attribution/replay/live-vault checks, covering CreateAccount or native Payment. It also reserves unsettled claim gross plus fee. Scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed; tests/compilation remain unrun and there are no open/confirm endpoints, provider account quorum, atomic mutation, or admission. Provider independence and live evidence freshness remain unresolved. No live Horizon outcall, deposit credit, registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.evidenceText: Commit 9f8eb5a7 adds a pure deposit-evidence decision module for exact receipt quorum/dissent, reserve freshness, first-funding attribution and replay/live-vault checks, and unsettled claim gross-plus-fee reservation. It handles either CreateAccount or native Payment proof. Scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed; tests and compilation remain unrun. No open/confirm endpoints, provider account quorum, or atomic state mutation exists. Credit/key/receipt/status state is still dormant. Unsettled claim gross plus fee is reserved. Scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed, but tests and compilation remain unrun. cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: The pure deposit-evidence helper reserves unsettled claim gross plus fee, but does not implement live claim settlement or payout. Transaction-status transport preserves fee and normalized not-found evidence in source; its 39 policy tests remain unrun. No Cargo/dfx test or live call has verified transport or claim reservations. Provider independence and live evidence freshness remain unresolved, so WP4 stays blocked. The XRP post-sign status race is a separate reuse caution, not an XLM-specific required gate. Reserve/oracle checks, testnet, frontend, and release remain open. Frozen config prevents XLM admission.

cards.evidenceText: Earlier Candid regeneration and compatibility checks passed. cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: Earlier focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34 before these commits. Commit 9f8eb5a7 adds pure deposit-evidence quorum, freshness, first-funding credit, replay/live-vault, and claim-reservation decisions; scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed but tests/compilation remain unrun. No open/confirm endpoints, independent provider account quorum, or atomic state mutation exists. Status transport preserves `fee_charged` and normalized not-found evidence in source; the parser policy's 39 tests remain unrun. Remaining blockers are live provider independence/freshness, full deposit credit and claim settlement, current oracle/reserve checks, frontend/testnet, and release. The live XRP post-sign status race is a separate reuse caution, not an XLM gate. WP3/WP4 remain blocked; no live provider/oracle proof, admission, or deployment.
